text: {"lessons":["A rising account value over a few months does not prove my trades are outperforming the market; I should judge results over longer periods against a suitable benchmark.","Repeated buying and selling can leave me reacting to short-term moves. I should have clear reasons and rules for each trade rather than trading just because prices changed.","Before adding to a position, I should consider the risk and size of my total exposure, and decide in advance what would make me hold, reduce, or sell."]}
